title: 3.3.6b Lab — Read a 3D property
description: Access and log p.shape.position.x each frame to see how to read a nested property through a class instance.

steps.title: Log p.shape.position.x in draw()
steps.instructions: In draw(), write `console.log(p.shape.position.x)` to print the planet's X position each frame. Open the Console panel below the editor to see the output.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer on the right and look up the position property.
